title: Source
description: An original input: an upload, a generation, a recording or an imported stem (02 §3.2).

originalAsset.description: The exact bytes the user provided (or that were generated).

workingAsset.description: The 48 kHz 24-bit FLAC produced by ingest.

durationSamples.description: Length of the working asset in samples at 48 kHz.

label.description: E.g. the original filename, or "Generated: dreamy outro".

placement.description: Set when the source is placed by the user or a generation, not laid out by `analysis.apply`: the section whose lanes hold this source's audio (02 §3.2, §6).

SourcePlacement.description: Where a placed source lives in the arrangement. `analysis.apply` does not build a baseline block for such a source; it maps the source's stems into this span (02 §6). Without `range` the placement owns the whole section (an extend); with it, the placement owns only that span (a fill), which may cross into the following sections.

sectionId.description: The section the placement is anchored to. A `range` starts inside it.

range.description: A gap range in ticks, relative to the anchored section's start; `endTick` may lie past that section's length (02 §6.4). Absent = the whole section.

srcStartSamples.description: The source sample that plays at `range.startTick`: a fill skips the left overlap before the gap. Required with `range` (02 §6.4).
